title: Prismatic Gems
description: Five new gem tiers — Sapphire, Nephia, Ruby, Enderite, and the mighty Onyx.
body:
💎 Prismatic — Five New Gems

Sapphire. Nephia. Ruby. Enderite. Onyx. Five new tiers woven into Minecraft's progression, each with its own ore, tools, armor, and set bonus.

The Tier Ladder

Iron < Sapphire < Nephia < Diamond < Ruby < Netherite < Enderite < Onyx

Each gem slots naturally between vanilla tiers, so there's always a next goal to chase.

The Five Gems

💙 Sapphire — found deep underground like diamond. Full set: -15% damage from aquatic mobs (drowned, guardians, pufferfish). Higher enchantability than diamond.

🧡 Nephia — a black-and-orange gem hidden in the Nether's crimson and warped forests. Full set: -10% fire damage.

❤️ Ruby — mined high in mountain biomes. Full set: -15% fall damage. Mines obsidian.

💜 Enderite — a glowing crystal from the End. Full set: -15% damage from endermen and the dragon, plus a 15% chance for bonus ender pearls on enderman kills.

🖤 Onyx — the endgame. Onyx ore hides near bedrock, brutally rare. Mine onyx shards, combine 4 shards + 4 diamonds into an onyx ingot, then upgrade your Enderite gear with an onyx ingot and template. Full set: -15% incoming damage AND +15% melee damage. Fireproof, like netherite.

Features


5 gems × (ore + gem + 5 tools + 4 armor pieces) — a complete equipment line for each
Ores generate in fitting locations: underground, mountains, Nether forests, the End, and near bedrock
All ores drop XP, respect Fortune and Silk Touch, and need the right pickaxe tier
Full enchantment and repair support
Vanilla-quality textures built on real block backgrounds


Requirements


Minecraft 26.2
Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
Fabric API
